redact_salary.description: true: salary and pay are hidden before anything is sent. false: pay is left visible (demo toggle).

medical_mode.description: generalize: medical details become placeholders and work restrictions. block: a note with medical details is not sent.

max_retries.description: How many times on-device redaction may retry before it blocks (0 to 5).

cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model used for drafting. Keep it on a 3.x model.
